checks.name: Production site URL
checks.detail: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the final public HTTPS origin.

checks.name: Approved USD/ZAR rate
checks.detail: The central approved rate must be a positive number.

checks.name: Pricing rate date
checks.detail: Configured rate is 18 day(s) old; launch requires 14 days or less.

checks.name: VAT treatment
checks.detail: Set VAT_DISPLAY_MODE to none, inclusive or exclusive after confirming the business treatment. "none" is a valid final choice for a business that does not charge VAT, not only a placeholder.

checks.name: Enquiry delivery
checks.detail: Configure the documented Resend recipient, provider, API key and verified sender values.

checks.name: Public contact route
checks.detail: Set at least BUSINESS_EMAIL or BUSINESS_PHONE so customers have a fallback contact route.

checks.name: Legal-content approval
checks.detail: Set LEGAL_CONTENT_APPROVED=true only after the privacy notice and website terms have been reviewed for the operating business.
